description:
Read a resting bid: shares wanted, sBTC escrowed, and the price that implies.

Read-only. Defaults to the unlocked wallet, which requires one; pass an address to read anyone without unlocking.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Bidder to read. Defaults to the unlocked wallet.

side.description: Which side: "yes"/"bonded" (pays if the coins entered a PoX-5 bond) or "no"/"idle" (pays if they did not).

name: atstake_get_bid
